description: Core generation, 30-band. AI agents CONSTRUCT each scaffolded notebook up to the rubric — the headline 'AI builds the tutorial' capability. This generalizes the notebook-filling loop the project used offline (Ralph) into an in-app agentic constructor driven by the BYO-key LLM client from 20, filling the 8 rubric sections with real explanations, worked examples, and runnable cells. Depends on 20 (subjects + scaffolds + LLM client). Anti-fabrication: a notebook is 'constructed' only when nbstatus.py reports ✅ AND tests/test_notebooks.py passes for it; Resources sections must contain real URLs, and runnable topics must contain cells that actually execute. Never flip a status or story on an unfilled or non-executing notebook.
warmup: echo '--- a completed exemplar to match ---'; for f in $(find notebooks -name '*.ipynb'); do python3 nbstatus.py --one "$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -q complete && { echo $f; break; }; done

userStories.title: Construction agent fills a notebook to the rubric
acceptanceCriteria: Given a scaffolded topic, an AI construction agent (LLM client from 20) fills the 8 rubric sections per docs/notebook-rubric.md: What & Why, Mental Model, Key Concepts, Setup, at least two Worked Examples, Gotchas & Pitfalls, When to Use vs Alternatives, and Resources with real URLs.
For runnable topics the agent writes real, executing code cells (a `%pip install` where needed); for conceptual topics it follows the rubric's conceptual path.
The filled notebook passes the existing completion gate: nbstatus.py reports ✅ and tests/test_notebooks.py passes for it.
Gate green: pytest passes, including the newly constructed notebook.

userStories.title: In-app construction flow with live status, batched across a curriculum
acceptanceCriteria: From the app the user triggers construction for a topic or a whole subject/curriculum; construction runs and the 🔴→🟡→✅ transitions surface live in the UI.
Batch construction across a curriculum is resumable and idempotent — re-running skips notebooks already ✅ and does not clobber them.
Constructed notebooks land in the library (from tasklist 10) and are immediately browsable/openable.
Gate green: cargo build + npm run build pass and at least one constructed notebook passes the completion gate; document the end-to-end run (define → scaffold → construct) in the progress log.
